$schema: PAT tracking manifest for automated expiration reminders. See .github/workflows/check-pat-expiration.yml. Names follow the PAT_<scope>_<purpose> convention (scope in {godimas, tcs, mod}, purpose in {push, read, project, deploy, sync}) — established 2026-09-02 during tcs-docs#58 audit. Use expires: "never" for intentionally never-expiring PATs; the workflow skips those.
